
## git: gitContext across every precedence branch
gitContext(plain-dir) = "no-repo"
gitContext(clean) = "clean"
gitContext(no-remote) = "no-remote"
gitContext(dirty) = "dirty-at-start"
gitContext(detached) = "detached"
gitContext(detached-dirty) = "detached"
gitContext(dirty-no-remote) = "dirty-at-start"
gitContext(empty) = "no-remote"
gitContext(history) = "clean"
gitContext(survival) = "clean"
gitContext(nonexistent path) = "no-repo"
